raw: {"analysis":"MKS provides a more structured and comprehensive delivery plan that addresses all key constraints: the 400ms replica lag with specific fallback logic, CI cost management through mandatory local verification, frozen auth library avoidance, explicit dual-approval gates, and the load balancer cache issue with targeted monitoring. TBF covers similar ground but is less precise on the replica lag mitigation (only mentions simulation tests, not actual fallback logic) and introduces a staging deployment phase that may consume CI resources unnecessarily. MKS also better addresses the rate limiting counter accuracy by specifying it must increment on the original request identity rather than the translated internal call.","verdict":"MKS"}
